title: 第15章 法与术第16章 命定星
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
回到自己家后，张绝关紧了房门。
他家徒四壁，没什么东西好收拾的。
唯一舍不得的就是那把平常用的最多的竹椅，这次离开显然不能搬着它一起走了。
距离午夜还剩几个小时，张绝没有回床上休息，而是躺在竹椅上，摇摇晃晃的翻开了脑海中的《太平道》。
“哗啦啦”的书页翻动声响起，此时能清楚地看到那些画像下的进度条都有了明显的增长。
当最后书页翻回到属于张绝自己的那一页后，上面数字的变化也更加印证了这一点。
【太平气：504】
【职业：散星法师（初职一阶）：8500】
今天一直在东奔西跑，张绝始终没注意到太平气的变化，他只是知道自己在帮过那些人后，他们画像下的进度条全都一直在涨。
可让他有些没想到的是，最后提供出来的太平气居然有这么多！
张绝思索着，翻看着后面那一页页的画像，发现除了老刘头以外，井水巷中的这些邻居平均下来每人都给他提供30到50点不等的太平气。
和平日一点两点的积攒差距很大。
这也变相证实了张绝此前测试得出的结论——每当他对画像上的人提供的帮助越大、影响越深远，反馈到他身上的太平气也就越多。
就算是从纯粹的利益角度来说，平日里同校的那些同学对张绝的嗤之以鼻一点也没错。
他平时勤勤恳恳，友爱邻里的行为确实只是小善，外修不了《公允法》救国，内攒不了《太平道》养气。
但正如张绝的初心本就不是为了什么提升境界，增强实力才去做那些邻里互助的事情。
他只是单纯地喜欢这种氛围，喜欢做这些事。
这会让他在这个陌生的世界，找回一些曾经的熟悉的感觉。
就在张绝享受着竹椅上的安逸时，《太平道》中的一张画像忽然引起了他的注意。
那是一个和他同龄的瘦弱少年——

方勉，方懋卿。
他的画像会出现这没什么好奇怪的，张绝今天也算是救了他，对他有大恩。
真正特殊的是，画像下的进度条和他所提供的太平气。
就和老刘头一样，那道进度条仅仅只是涨了一点点，却足足给张绝一次性提供了一百多点的太平气！
这个时候张绝已经琢磨出味来了，太平气提供的多少，有可能依据的不仅仅是他对画像个人的帮助有多大。
还综合了他在选择帮助这个人后，造成的影响会有多大。
就比如老刘头。
张绝在刚开始答应他，去接受安焕然发布的任务时，其实并没有给他提供任何实质上的帮助。
可他画像下的进度条却就偏偏只涨了一些，也就是涨的这一些，就反馈了张绝远超平常的太平气。
这大概率是因为，在张绝真的下定决心打算参与进这件事时，《太平道》就判断他对老刘头的承诺和帮助足以影响很多人。
事实也确实如此，不仅仅是井水巷中的这些邻居，他选择去接下那把剑的任务，就等于陷入了新法、旧法争执的最中心。
那方勉又是因为什么呢？
content_en:
After returning to his home, Zhang Jue closed the door tightly.
His house had only four walls and nothing to clean up.
The only thing I couldn't bear to part with was the bamboo chair I used the most. Obviously I couldn't take it with me when I left this time.
There were still a few hours left before midnight. Zhang Jue did not go back to bed to rest. Instead, he lay on the bamboo chair and staggeredly opened the book "Taiping Dao" in his mind.
The sound of pages turning was heard, and it was clearly visible that the progress bars under the portraits had grown significantly.
When the last page of the book was turned back to Zhang Jue's own page, the changes in the numbers above further confirmed this point.
【Taipingqi: 504】
[Occupation: Scattered Star Mage (First Level of Initial Job): 8500]
Having been running around today, Zhang Jue never noticed the changes in Tai Pingqi. He just knew that after he helped those people, the progress bars under their portraits kept rising.
But what he didn't expect was that there was so much Taiping Qi provided in the end!
Zhang Jue thought about it, flipping through the pages of portraits at the back, and found that except for Old Liu Tou, each of the neighbors in Jingshui Lane provided him with an average of 30 to 50 points of peace.
There is a big difference between the daily accumulation of one and two o'clock.
This also confirmed Zhang Jue's conclusion from previous tests in disguise - whenever he provided more help and more profound influence to the people in the portrait, more peace would be fed back to him.
Even from a purely profit perspective, it is not wrong for those classmates in the same school to sneer at Zhang Jue.
His usually diligent and friendly behavior towards his neighbors is indeed just a small act of kindness. He cannot save the country by cultivating the "Justice Law" externally, nor can he cultivate the "Taiping Dao" internally.
But just as Zhang Jue's original intention was not to improve his realm and strengthen his strength, he only did things to help neighbors.
He just simply likes this atmosphere and doing these things.
This will allow him to regain some familiar feelings in this strange world.
While Zhang Jue was enjoying the comfort of the bamboo chair, a portrait in "Taiping Dao" suddenly caught his attention.
That was a thin boy of the same age as him——
Fang Mian, Fang Maoqing.
It's not surprising that his portrait would appear. Zhang Jue saved him today and was very kind to him.
What's really special is the progress bar under the portrait and the peace he provides.
Just like Old Liu Tou, the progress bar only increased a little, but it was enough to provide Zhang Jue with more than a hundred points of peace at once!
At this time, Zhang Jue had already figured out that the amount of Taiping Qi provided might be based on more than just how helpful he was to the individual portrait.
It also combines how much impact he will have after choosing to help this person.
Just like Lao Liutou.
When Zhang Jue first agreed to accept the task issued by An Huanran, he actually did not provide him with any substantial help.
But the progress bar under his portrait only increased a little, which reflected Zhang Jueyuan's extraordinary peace of mind.
This is most likely because when Zhang Juezhen made up his mind to get involved in this matter, "Taipingdao" judged that his commitment and help to Old Liu Tou were enough to influence many people.
This is indeed the case. Not only are these neighbors in Jingshui Lane, but his choice to take over the task of that sword means that he has fallen into the center of the dispute between the new law and the old law.
So what's the reason for Fang Mian?
